name: SparklineGroup
remarks: The SparklineGroup object can contain multiple sparklines, and contains the property settings for the group, such as color and axis settings. Each sparkline is represented by a Sparkline object. Use the Modify method to add or remove sparklines from the sparkline group. Use the ModifyLocation method to change the location of the sparkline, and use the ModifySourceData method to change the range of the source data.
example:
Dim mySG As SparklineGroup
Set mySG = Range("$A$1:$A$4").SparklineGroups.Add(Type:=xlSparkColumn, SourceData:= _
 "Sheet2!B1:E4")

mySG.SeriesColor.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of sparklines in the sparkline group. Read-only.

properties.name: Location
properties.description: Gets or sets the Range object that represents the location of the sparkline group. Read/write.

properties.name: SourceData
properties.description: Returns or sets the range that contains the source data for the sparkline group. Read/write.

properties.name: DateRange
properties.description: Gets or sets the date range for the sparkline group. Read/write.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Gets or sets the type of sparkline for the group. Read/write.

properties.name: SeriesColor
properties.description: Returns a FormatColor object that represents the main series color for the sparkline group. Read-only.

properties.name: Points
properties.description: Returns the associated SparkPoints object for the sparkline group. Read-only.

properties.name: Axes
properties.description: Returns the associated SparkAxes object. Read-only.

properties.name: DisplayHidden
properties.description: Specifies if hidden cells are plotted in the sparkline group. Read/write.

properties.name: LineWeight
properties.description: Gets or sets the thickness of the sparklines in the sparkline group. Read/write.

properties.name: PlotBy
properties.description: Returns or sets how to plot the sparkline when the data on which it is based is in a square-shaped range. Read/write.

methods.name: ModifyLocation
methods.description: Sets the associated Range object to modify the location of the sparkline group.

parameters.name: Location
parameters.description: The range that represents the location of the sparkline group.

methods.name: ModifySourceData
methods.description: Sets the range that represents the source data for the sparkline group.

parameters.name: SourceData
parameters.description: The range that represents the source data.

methods.name: Modify
methods.signature: Modify(Location As Range, SourceData As String)
methods.description: Sets the location and the source data for the sparkline group.

parameters.name: Location
parameters.description: The Range object that represents the location of the sparkline group.

parameters.name: SourceData
parameters.description: The range that represents the source data for the sparkline group.

methods.name: ModifyDateRange
methods.description: Sets the date range for the sparkline group.

parameters.name: DateRange
parameters.description: The date range for the sparkline group.
